route.meaning: Move the current DomainSpec v2 Product lineage into active Craft roots while retaining old-name paths as immutable migration and historical evidence.

phases.action: Refresh the source manifest, path-consumer inventory, git-state capture, and map digests against one frozen current working-source epoch.
phases.completion: Every selected input has an exact path, digest, git state, owner, and migration disposition; no source byte changes during the capture.

phases.action: Complete the current-name Craft entry surfaces and identity links without treating DomainSpec v2 as a predecessor Product.
phases.completion: Product, Project, Method, ontology, and source maps agree on CA2-PRODUCT-CRAFT, CA2-PROJECT-CRAFT, CAV2-D20, and same-product-renamed.

phases.action: Partition the refreshed source and all literal-path consumers into active Craft dependencies, retained legacy evidence, development continuations, completed evidence, superseded evidence, and historical evidence.
phases.completion: Every source entry and every old-root occurrence has one explicit disposition; runtime dependencies do not point into an excluded transient or archive.

phases.action: Materialize current Product, architecture, authority, ontology, research, and language-neutral formalization bytes into their active Craft roots from the frozen working source.
phases.completion: Each copied byte is source-bound; active paths use Craft naming; original-path evidence remains unchanged in legacy evidence roots.

phases.action: Materialize one dependency-closed Node 26 implementation and CLI under cyberAlchemy-v2/implementation/craft, including package locks, generators, profiles, ports, schemas, tests, and fixtures.
phases.completion: The Craft implementation installs, typechecks, tests, and builds standalone from its final active path without borrowing the legacy parent workspace.

phases.action: Carry the one development directory classified as an active runtime dependency and rebind only its current consumers.
phases.completion: The selected runtime dependency is present once in Craft and its real consumers pass from the final path.

phases.action: Carry all active and blocked continuation directories as non-canonical development state without executing their pending work.
phases.completion: All 26 continuation directories are present with lifecycle and residue intact and none is misreported as completed or admitted.

phases.action: Copy completed development packages into the Craft evidence area while retaining their original source path and digest identities.
phases.completion: All 16 completed packages are preserved as evidence and none becomes an active runtime dependency merely by migration.

phases.action: Archive the superseded development packages under the Craft evidence surface.
phases.completion: All four superseded packages retain provenance and have no active consumer or authority role.

phases.action: Archive historical development packages without rewriting their historical claims or path-bound evidence.
phases.completion: All six historical packages remain discoverable and are excluded from current runtime and authority surfaces.

phases.action: Rewrite current consumers to final Craft roots, preserve explicitly historical old-root references, and create a machine allowlist for every retained DomainSpec-v2 occurrence.
phases.completion: Every refreshed path-consumer row is either rebound to Craft or justified as immutable legacy evidence; no unexplained old-root occurrence remains.

phases.action: Run the complete final-path validation surface: Node 26 runtime, install, typecheck, unit and contract tests, CLI build, generation, three language profiles, Operation and Workflow relationships/effects/recovery, independent conformance, target-project materialization, and two-run determinism.
phases.completion: One source-to-target-project-to-independent-conformance vertical passes twice from final Craft paths with exact realization, content, and evidence digests.

phases.action: Freeze the passing final-path graph as the first current Craft baseline, switch current internal references to it, and mark DomainSpec-v2 roots as read-only legacy evidence with compatibility locators.
phases.completion: Craft is the sole current active Product path; legacy roots remain readable and reversible; no source deletion, publication, release, or deployment occurs.

validation_obligations: all 53 development directories are selected exactly once by the five directory waves
all refreshed source entries have exactly one active, continuation, completed, superseded, historical, or retained-legacy disposition
all refreshed literal old-root occurrences are rebound or allowlisted as immutable evidence
active imports and package identities use Craft roots and names
the final implementation is standalone under the repository Node 26 container
TypeScript, Python, and Rust profile realizations remain selected and independently conformant

Operation and Workflow constraints include declared reads, writes, effects, guards, atomic state and outbox, explicit failure continuation, undeclared-effect rejection, relationship rules, and durable recovery bindings
a mock target project can be created from typed intent and independently checked against exact selected realization and byte digests
two identical runs produce identical target bytes, manifests, and conformance results
no numbered baseline candidate is used as a substitute for final-path validation

execution_blockers.meaning: The latest numbered baseline-v11 candidate has no passing aggregate receipt and is diagnostic evidence only, not a migration source.
The 1,027 consumer files and 9,073 old-root occurrences are inventoried but not yet partitioned into current rewrites and immutable evidence allowlist entries.

claim_ceiling: This order defines dependency and evidence sequence only. It does not itself copy, rename, rebind, validate, freeze, switch authority, delete legacy roots, publish, release, deploy, or prove production readiness.
